measurementLimit: Includes external press/drag injection and driver query/event/poll costs; differs from historical shaded-first-frame workload. White pixels witness the window drawable, not compositor presentation. Not native capture/outline-removal or mixed-DPI proof.
scope: physical Cinnamon X11 release hotkey to first drawn white outline on every actual transparent selector; synthetic canvases; scale1 shared vertical strip; Escape cancellation
selectorOwnership: resident or exact supplied executable immediate child PID/start/device/inode

timingDefinitions.mapMs: All selector map events discovered and owner/override-redirect validated
timingDefinitions.mapOwnershipQueriesMs: Subset of mapEventDrainMs; synchronous ownership and attribute queries
timingDefinitions.paintQueriesMs: Sum of synchronous position, geometry and white-pixel witness queries
timingDefinitions.pollSleepMs: Actual elapsed one-millisecond poll sleeps, including scheduling delay
timingDefinitions.windowWitnesses: Driver-observed map event, validation and first white drawable pixel per selector
